title: Missing XML sitemap declared in robots.txt or available at /sitemap.xml
evidence: Request to https://www.mozilla.org/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 and https://www.mozilla.org/robots.txt contains no 'Sitemap:' directive, increasing crawl discovery cost for search engines and AI web indexing agents.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap and declare its location in robots.txt.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Generate a comprehensive sitemap.xml covering localized routes and add 'Sitemap: https://www.mozilla.org/sitemap.xml' to the root robots.txt file.

title: Missing Schema.org Product and Offer structured data on commercial product page
evidence: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ contains 0 JSON-LD blocks, omitting machine-readable Product and Offer metadata for subscription pricing tiers, feature lists, and regional availability.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org Product and Offer JSON-LD to commercial product pages.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script tag on /products/vpn/ specifying @type 'Product' with nested 'Offer' elements defining price, priceCurrency, billing duration, and availability.

title: Missing Organization JSON-LD markup on primary root homepage
evidence: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ contains 0 JSON-LD schema blocks, missing root Organization identity, official logo, and sameAs authoritative social and entity links directly on the primary domain landing page.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an Organization schema block on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ with name ('Mozilla'), url ('https://www.mozilla.org'), logo, and sameAs links to Wikipedia, Wikidata, GitHub, and official social channels.
